item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA

item.title: Review: BYD Short Sellers Retreat Ahead of Expected Profit Rebound
item.description: Short sellers are paring back bets against BYD Co. ahead of earnings, with the Chinese electric vehicle giant poised to post a rebound in profit helped by accelerating overseas sales and a domestic market recovery.
item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA
